estimates.label: Modeled Oakland County employment descriptive comparison gap

period.label: 2024 Oakland County outcome relative to a mechanically matched 20-county benchmark; DET01 operational-no-later-than year 2015

scope.label: Oakland County descriptive economic comparison

interval.interpretation: Low, central and high values are an explicit sensitivity envelope, not a confidence interval.

provenance.detail: Oakland County 2024 employment from the governed county panel

parameters.name: comparison_2024_value

provenance.detail: Inverse-distance weighted 2024 employment from 20 non-study counties

parameters.transformation: Subtracted from host and used as denominator

parameters.name: pre_period_rmse_percent

provenance.detail: Mechanical fit diagnostic over 2007-2014

parameters.transformation: Sets sensitivity half-width at two times RMSE with a five-point floor

provenance.detail: Operational-no-later-than year, not exact commissioning

estimates.confidence_rationale: The calculation is reproducible but lacks a causal comparison design, contamination audit, placebo tests and treatment isolation.
estimates.decision_relevance: Describes 2024 divergence from a mechanical benchmark without attributing it to DET01.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Registered causal design, verified treatment timing, exposure-screened controls, pre-trend/placebo/robustness diagnostics and longer post-period

derivation.formula: 100 × (Oakland 2024 outcome − weighted comparison outcome) ÷ weighted comparison outcome; interval half-width = max(5, 2 × 2007-2014 pre-period RMSE)
assumptions: Donors are the 20 nearest non-study counties on pre-2015 level, trend and volatility under the repository's mechanical matching rule.
Unknown data-center exposure and concurrent investments are not fully screened.
The operational-no-later-than date does not isolate exact treatment or expansion timing.

limitations: Descriptive only; must not be called an effect.
Shared county outcomes include all Oakland County activity.
The interval is fit sensitivity, not statistical uncertainty.
estimates.notes: No causal_design is attached because causal publication gates do not pass.
